summary: Re-ran public backend and mobile Expo checks after the compatibility fix. Health and all unauthenticated protection checks passed; Indonesian login loaded and Google OAuth reached Google's sign-in page without crashing.
action_items: Provide a Google OAuth test account to verify session exchange, authenticated dashboard loading, RBAC, and drawer flows.
Implement the remaining Akses / User and Pengaturan modules when product requirements are finalized.
critical_code_review_comments: No hardcoded backend URL found: frontend resolves configured Expo extra, EXPO_BACKEND_URL, then EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
Authenticated positive paths remain unverified because /app/memory/test_credentials.md confirms no Google test account is available.
Most authenticated Pressable controls lack explicit testID attributes, limiting robust mobile regression selectors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No Google test account exists. OAuth initiation was verified through the Google sign-in page; do not claim session exchange or authenticated RBAC success.
rca_of_issue: No runtime issue reproduced. GET /api/health returned 200; six protected endpoints returned 401 without tokens; fabricated OAuth session returned 401. Mobile login rendered in Indonesian and google-login-button redirected to accounts.google.com.
